profile.title: AI & Data Engineer
profile.intro: I am a final-year Master's student specializing in Data and Artificial Intelligence at ESILV. My work focuses on building innovative AI solutions, from graph neural networks (GNN) to the design of complex multi-agent architectures.
profile.vision: My goal is to bridge robust data engineering and generative AI applications to solve concrete industrial problems, especially in 3D environments and automation.

education.description: Specialization in Deep Learning, NLP, Big Data and MLOps.
Mathematics, physics, chemistry and computer science preparation for engineering school.

experience.description:
• Graph Neural Networks (GNN): designed and trained GNN models from scratch
to classify complex 3D data from CATIA.

• Data Engineering & Preprocessing: extracted, cleaned and structured complex,
heterogeneous industrial data.

• Project Management & Client Relations: worked with clients in the
Transportation & Mobility industry to gather requirements, scope and lead
strategic projects.

• Agentic Model Evaluation: tested usage scenarios on AI agents and structured
technical feedback to guide the teams developing them.

• Anomaly Detection (ML): built a pipeline to analyze PCAP files and trained
ML models to proactively detect network incidents.

• NLP Chatbot & Automation: developed an internal virtual assistant (NLP) to
query technical documentation and speed up access to information.

• AI & Development: optimized the core AI algorithm. Wrote unit and functional
tests to make the application robust.

• Strategy: took part in UX and architecture brainstorming.
Tutoring for middle and high school students.

projects.title: 3D Assembly Detection with GNNs
projects.shortDescription: Graph neural network architectures to extract features from CAD models.
projects.description:
R&D project building GNN architectures to extract geometric features and analyze B-Rep topology in CATIA. The project also explores protocols for Agent-to-Agent communication.

projects.title: Financial Video Generator
projects.shortDescription: Automated pipeline that creates animated financial content for social media.
projects.description: Automated scripts that generate animations of financial performance (DCA) for TikTok. The system combines stock market data retrieval, animated chart generation and an LLM workflow for the voice-over.

projects.title: Rhythm Video Game
projects.shortDescription: Rhythm game built in Python and synchronized to the music.
projects.description: A custom rhythm video game where the gameplay is generated and synchronized directly from the analysis of the audio tracks.

projects.title: Big Data Analysis
projects.shortDescription: ETL pipeline (PySpark) for batch and streaming processing of massive transaction logs. Modeling for near real-time trend analysis, improving responsiveness to stock shortages.
